events.name: ypy:telemetry:error
events.description: Fires for every failure of the page, whatever its source: a network failure, a timeout, a lost connection, a response with status 400 or more, a target that matches nothing, a swap that failed or was refused, an error of an extension. `detail` is `{code, url, method, status, target, ctxId}`: `code` is stable (`network`, `offline`, `timeout`, `status:<n>`, `target-missing`, `swap-error`, `blocked:<reason>`, `extension:<name>`, `error`), `url` has no query, fragment or credentials, and `ctxId` is shared by the reports of one request. It never carries a body, a field value, a header, a cookie or an error message.
